name: Asuma [Wind Blade]
balanceNote: Screenshot coefficients and Repulse chance are unspecified. Local values: Mystery 1.8 Physical ATK total, standard 0.9, chase 1.1, Repulse chance 45%. Multiple animation hits split total damage, never multiply it. Pose of Invincibility is a nonstacking 30% Physical ATK aura for full-HP allied ninjas while Asuma is alive; Ninjutsu is replaced, not added a second time. No autonomous summon exists in this skill kit.

mystery.name: Flying Swallow - Wind Blade
mystery.description: Causes damage to up to 3 units in the opponent's lineup, causes Knockdown to the selected unit. Cooldown 3; Battlefield Cooldown 1; Chakra Cost 40.

standard.name: Chakra Blade - Straight Line
standard.description: Attacks up to 3 opponent units in the front row, a chance of causing Repulse.

courage.name: Courage
courage.description: At the beginning of the battle, recovers 20 Chakra.

chase.name: Fire Style - Burning Ash
chase.description: Chases and Attacks a Repulsed unit, causes Knockdown and Blindness. Blindness: affected units cannot execute Standard Attacks. Lasts for 1 round.

aura.name: Pose of Invincibility
aura.description: While Asuma is alive, ninjas in your lineup having full HP will have their Physical ATK increased by 30%.
